chunks: And with this chain, from Abi al-Hasan, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Qays ibn al-Rabi', from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who lies down to his bed and recites 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' eleven times, Allah will protect him in his house and in the surrounding areas.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas eleven times before bed?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith highlights the protective power of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas eleven times before sleep, a practice rooted in the Imams' emphasis on domestic spiritual security. It underscores the belief that the divine name 'Allah' serves as a shield, preserving the household and its perimeter from unseen harms, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating Quranic recitation into daily rituals for both physical and spiritual safeguarding.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7. And from the previous chain from Abi al-Hassan from Aban b. Uthman from Qays b. al-Rabee’ from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who recites Surah Tauheed eleven times before going to bed Allah will protect his house along with all the neighboring houses.”
